scope: NVIDIA GB10 only; one request/stream; Gemma4 E4B IT QAT Q4_0; three fixed prompts/output budgets; warmed runs; no global-fastest or cross-engine quality-equivalence claim

protocol.cpu_affinity: two CPUs via taskset campaign launch; native/llama per-thread affinity was not sampled by HTTP harness
protocol.statistics: exact empirical percentile bootstrap of median, all3125 resamples per five-sample block; independent product distributions for engine ratios
protocol.statistics_limit: 95% intervals describe five samples within one engine block. Blocks are independent, not paired/randomized; do not estimate cross-session variance.
protocol.decode_metric: (completion_tokens - 1) / (terminal_usage_time - first_visible_content_time); visible-content-based SSE proxy assumes first visible content is one token
protocol.token_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of little-endian unsigned32 prompt token IDs

precision_caveat: Same learned GGUF bytes/F16 KV; different runtime arithmetic. Antfly retains F32 hidden state with selected Q8 activation-dot paths and BF16 prefill mirrors. vLLM uses F16 activations/backend reductions. llama.cpp uses its GGUF CUDA implementation. Native candidate/control text/count/finish matches; that does not prove equal cross-engine quality.

Use the following notes to design a complete workflow.
The archive team receives recorded interviews each morning. An intake worker checks the file, records its source, and assigns a durable job identifier. The processing service extracts the audio track and detects its language. A transcription worker produces text while retaining timing and source provenance. Reviewers correct names and mark uncertain passages. Approved text is indexed so that researchers can find relevant discussions later. A failed worker releases its lease, and another worker resumes from the last persisted result.
